details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~1 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Empty MCP_INCOMPATIBLE_REVIEWER_MODELS can bypass the intended default deny-list.
  WHY: An explicitly empty override can disable the incompatibility guard and send MCP-enabled configs to unsupported models.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~2 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The no-MCP prompt path is not validated before use.
  WHY: A missing prompt_body_file_no_mcp / REVIEWER_PROMPT_BODY_FILE_NO_MCP can leave incompatible models with an invalid prompt file.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~3 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The no-MCP prompt variant depends on exact placeholder substitution.
  WHY: If the template marker changes or substitution fails, the prompt can retain an unsubstituted MCP-related placeholder and misrepresent tool availability.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~2 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: is_mcp_incompatible_model uses fragile substring/pattern matching instead of exact slug matching.
  WHY: Partial matches can misclassify future models and either strip MCP unnecessarily or miss incompatible ones.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~1-~2 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: strip_all_mcp_server_blocks can fail without stopping the reviewer run.
  WHY: If the config rewrite or mv fails, MCP blocks remain in place and the original 422 failure path is reproduced.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~3 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The awk stripping pattern may not cover all MCP section variants.
  WHY: Any residual [mcp_servers.*] section keeps MCP tools registered and can still trigger 422s.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~1 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The hardcoded incompatible-model deny-list can become stale or miss newly incompatible models.
  WHY: Models not in the list will still get MCP-enabled configs until the list is updated.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~2 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Parallel reviewer passes may race on config.toml mutation.
  WHY: Concurrent reads and writes could expose a partially rewritten config despite the per-reviewer isolation.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~1 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Empty MCP_INCOMPATIBLE_REVIEWER_MODELS won't fall back to the intended default deny-list.
  WHY: An explicitly empty env var value can suppress the default incompatibility list and keep MCP enabled for broken models.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~2 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new prompt_body_file_no_mcp positional argument is not validated before use in run_reviewer_pass.
  WHY: If the call site omits the argument, the no-MCP path can use an empty or null file path and fail.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~2 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The no-MCP prompt file is not checked for existence before selection.
  WHY: If REVIEWER_PROMPT_BODY_FILE_NO_MCP was not generated successfully, the reviewer can be launched with a missing file.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~2 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: is_mcp_incompatible_model uses substring-based matching that is fragile.
  WHY: Partial model-name matches can incorrectly classify future slugs and apply the deny-list to the wrong models.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~1-~2 | severity=high | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: strip_all_mcp_server_blocks does not check for failures.
  WHY: If the awk filter or file move fails, the script continues with the original MCP-enabled config and reproduces the 422 error.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~3 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The no-MCP prompt depends on exact `{{SERENA_EFFICIENCY_BLOCK_READ_ONLY}}` placeholder substitution.
  WHY: If the placeholder format changes, the generated prompt may retain the unsubstituted marker and misrepresent available tools.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~1 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Explicitly setting MCP_INCOMPATIBLE_REVIEWER_MODELS to an empty string can disable the deny-list.
  WHY: The empty override can cause incompatible models to receive MCP-enabled configs and hit 422 errors.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~2 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The 6th positional prompt_body_file_no_mcp parameter is passed without validation.
  WHY: If the generated no-MCP prompt file is missing, the reviewer can be launched with a bad prompt path and fail.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~3 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The awk filter used by strip_all_mcp_server_blocks may not cover every TOML MCP section variant.
  WHY: Residual [mcp_servers.*] sections would keep MCP tools registered and still trigger the namespace-envelope 422 failure.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~2 | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Missing error handling on the config rewrite can leave MCP stripping silently ineffective.
  WHY: If awk or mv fails, the original MCP-enabled config remains in place and the incompatible-provider failure repeats.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~2 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Model slug matching for incompatibility detection is fragile.
  WHY: Substring-style matching can misclassify future slugs, stripping MCP from compatible models or missing incompatible ones.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~3 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The no-MCP prompt variant depends on an exact placeholder name.
  WHY: If the source prompt template changes, the substitution can fail silently and leave malformed prompt text.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~1 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The hardcoded deny-list can become stale as upstream model behavior changes.
  WHY: If providers later fix responses-API support, the list must be updated or models will keep being treated as incompatible.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~1 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The empty-string case for MCP_INCOMPATIBLE_REVIEWER_MODELS is not handled explicitly.
  WHY: An empty override can bypass the intended default deny-list and leave incompatible models on the MCP path.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~2 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: run_reviewer_pass/run_reviewer plumbing adds the no-MCP prompt argument without validating it.
  WHY: A missing 6th positional argument can result in an invalid prompt file path for the incompatible-model branch.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~2 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: strip_all_mcp_server_blocks lacks verification that the config rewrite succeeded.
  WHY: A failed rewrite can leave MCP blocks in place and reproduce the original 422 error.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~2 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: is_mcp_incompatible_model should use exact slug comparison.
  WHY: Pattern-based matching can accidentally classify the wrong model slug and apply the MCP-stripping behavior incorrectly.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~3 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: REVIEWER_PROMPT_BODY_FILE_NO_MCP generation depends on a specific placeholder substitution.
  WHY: If the placeholder format changes or the substitution misses, the no-MCP prompt can be malformed or incomplete.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~1 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The hardcoded incompatible-model list can become stale over time.
  WHY: When upstream fixes the responses-API gap, the deny-list must be updated or the affected models will remain stripped of MCP unnecessarily.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~2 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Concurrent reviewer passes may race on config.toml mutation.
  WHY: Parallel reads and writes could expose a partially rewritten configuration file.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~2 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Models outside the known incompatible list have no fallback mitigation.
  WHY: A newly incompatible slug that is not added to the deny-list will still run with MCP enabled and hit the same 422 failure.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
